name: available-mixed
title: Updates available, every row kind
description: GetUpdates lists security, kernel, gnome-shell/mutter, WebKitGTK, GTK, libsoup, GLib and other updates plus two phased ones (PackageKit lists them as normal updates; the python3 phasing stub reports phasing_applied 1). GetUpdates is one batched Packages signal for a client that sets supports-plural-signals=true, and 24 Package signals for one that does not (packagekitd 1.3.4 sends the plural form only with that hint). GetDetails has no download-size (the apt backend case).
